title: 第3章 抢夺锦澜袈裟敲诈唐僧第4章 罪大恶极罄竹难书
slug: 西游反正很无聊随便打个劫呗
lines: “猴哥，你怎么样了？”
看到孙悟空的惨样，猪八戒都快急哭了。
虽然他平时和孙悟空不对付，但两人是有兄弟情义的。
“猴哥你快醒醒！”
不过孙悟空伤的太重了。
并没有醒来的迹象。
“大王，他们就在这里。”
一阵嘈杂的声音从远处传来。
那群山贼将师徒4人包围。
“敢骗我们大王，看你们还往那里跑！”
一名小喽啰，上前想要抓唐僧。
被沙和尚直接一掌推倒。
当然沙和尚还是留手了，并没有杀了对方。
“贫僧是从东土大唐到西天拜佛求经的和尚。”
“希望几位大王，看在上天有好生之德，放我们师徒过去。”
唐僧立刻求饶说道。
“我们大王这就来了，等着吧！”
楚云原本是打算带小喽啰们回去喝酒的。
不过一想到锦澜袈裟，九环锡杖，紫金钵盂。
便又带人回头折返回来。
“大王你来了！”
楚云分开众人，来到了唐僧师徒面前。
看了一眼地上的孙悟空。
这猴子运气怎么这么好？
才刚扔到水里，就这么快被捞上来了。
“这位大王！
我们是东土大唐，去往西天拜佛求经的和尚！”
“能不能网开一面，放我们西去！”
楚云摸了摸鼻子。
“当然可以了，不过你们要留下衣服，马匹还有财物！”
猪八戒受不了眼前强盗的嚣张，直接一拳打了过来。
“强盗，我去你的吧！”
楚云则是伸出两只手指，挡住了对方的恐怖一拳。
猪八戒瞬间感觉打在了钢铁上了。
虽然被打下凡间猪八戒的实力有损，但他也是一货真价实的金仙。
他的一拳，就这样被对方两只手指挡住了。
楚云随后一抬脚，将猪八戒踢到了一边。
沙僧连忙上前挡在唐僧面前。
他知道
眼前之人并不是普通人。
“东土大唐来的高僧，那身上一定有不少钱了！”
“交出200万两白银，就是放你们过去！”
此言一出，周围的一众小喽啰，都懵了。
他们大王居然狮子大开口，要200万两白银。
当然他们并不知道自己的大王，早已经得道成仙，而且还是神仙当中最强的那一类。
content_en:
"Brother Monkey, how are you?"
Seeing Sun Wukong's miserable state, Zhu Bajie almost burst into tears.
Although he usually doesn't deal with Sun Wukong, the two have a brotherly relationship.
"Brother Monkey, wake up quickly!"
But Sun Wukong was seriously injured.
There was no sign of waking up.
"Your Majesty, they are here."
A loud sound came from afar.
The group of bandits surrounded the four masters and apprentices.
"How dare you lie to our king, let's see where you go!"
A young man stepped forward to arrest Tang Seng.
He was directly pushed down by Monk Sha.
Of course, Monk Sha still held back and did not kill the other party.
"The poor monk is a monk who came from the Eastern Tang Dynasty to the Western Heaven to worship Buddha and seek scriptures."
"I hope that the kings, for the sake of God's good will, will let our masters and disciples go."
Tang Seng immediately begged for mercy.
"Our king is coming soon, just wait!"
Chu Yun originally planned to take the minions back for a drink.
But when I think of the Jinlan cassock, the nine-ring tin staff, and the purple gold alms bowl.
Then he took the people back and turned back.
"Your Majesty, you are here!"
Chu Yun separated the crowd and came to Tang Seng and his disciples.
He glanced at Sun Wukong on the ground.
Why is this monkey so lucky?
Just thrown into the water, it was fished out so quickly.
"This king!
We are monks from the Eastern Tang Dynasty who went to the Western Heaven to worship Buddha and seek scriptures! "
"Can you please be more generous and let us go west?"
Chu Yun touched his nose.
"Of course, but you have to keep your clothes, horses and belongings!"
Zhu Bajie couldn't stand the arrogance of the robber in front of him, so he punched him directly.
"Bandit, fuck you!"
Chu Yun stretched out two fingers to block the opponent's terrifying punch.
Zhu Bajie instantly felt like he was struck by steel.
Although Zhu Bajie's strength was damaged by being knocked down to the mortal world, he is still a genuine golden immortal.
His punch was blocked by the opponent's two fingers.
Chu Yun then raised his foot and kicked Zhu Bajie aside.
Sha Seng quickly stepped forward to block Tang Seng.
he knows
The person in front of me is not an ordinary person.
"The eminent monk from the Eastern Tang Dynasty must have a lot of money!"
"If I hand over 2 million taels of silver, I will let you go!"
As soon as these words came out, all the minions around were stunned.
Their king actually asked for 2 million taels of silver.
Of course, they didn't know that their king had already attained enlightenment and became an immortal, and he was also the strongest among the immortals.
title_en: Chapter 3: Stealing the Jinlan cassock and blackmailing Tang Monk Chapter 4: The crimes are so heinous that they are too numerous to describe
